title: Move config/trace TUIs + tap to grove-explore; forwarding shims + string sweep

plan.objective: Move config_tui, trace_tui, and tap.rs wholesale to grove-explore as grove-explore config/tap subcommands, add forwarding shims in the grove CLI, fix init.rs first-run TUI call, preserve GroveConfig.mode on save, and sweep single-server user strings.
key_changes: New grove-explore/Cargo.toml workspace crate with ratatui+crossterm deps; removes both from cli/Cargo.toml and removes the [[bin]] grove-explore block.
New grove-explore/src/main.rs dispatches serve/config/tap subcommands; serve becomes explicit (was a positional path arg).
Move 9 files verbatim from cli/src/{config_tui,trace_tui,tap.rs} to grove-explore/src/; update crate-internal references.
AC4 removal: drop grove_mode + explore_active from App; remove mode-badge, inert-render guards, and 4 now-trivial unit tests.
AC5 fix (blocker 2): save path re-reads mode from GroveConfig::load(root) before writing — mirrors harnesses pattern; mode never forced to McpLlm.
New unit test config_round_trip_preserves_mode_and_harnesses: builds from config.json with mode=mcp, simulates save, asserts mode==Mcp and harnesses preserved.
AC3 string sweep: tap.rs user strings updated from explore.json/grove-serve to config.json/grove-explore; doc strings updated.
cli/src/main.rs: remove 3 mod decls; Config and Tap match arms become exec shims printing deprecation note before forwarding.
cli/src/init.rs fix (blocker 1): replace crate::config_tui::run() with find_explore_binary() exec of grove-explore config; fix stale comment.
cli/tests/cli.rs: replace CARGO_BIN_EXE_grove-explore with grove_explore_bin() helper; update tap tests to seed/assert config.json.
5 new integration tests: shim prints new spelling (config+tap), grove-explore config non-TTY fails fast, grove-explore tap enables config.json, init absent grove-explore.
cargo tree check: ratatui/crossterm absent from grove-cst-cli dep tree; present in grove-explore-bin dep tree (AC6).

review_plan.objective: Reviewed the revised plan to move config/trace TUIs + tap into a new grove-explore workspace crate with forwarding shims and an explore.json string sweep.
key_changes: Blocker 1 fix verified: init.rs:136 does call crate::config_tui::run; Step 8a's find_explore_binary() exec (helper real at init.rs:597) prevents the compile break (AC7).
Blocker 2 fix verified: config_tui/mod.rs:103 writes mode: app.grove_mode; Step 6 re-reads existing.mode from disk mirroring harnesses pattern, satisfying AC5 (mode preserved, not forced McpLlm).
Dependency completeness verified: moved files import only anyhow, crossterm, grove_core, grove_explore_core, ratatui, serde_json (+serde) — all present in new grove-explore/Cargo.toml.
Wholesale-move premise confirmed: zero crate::{ops,engine,registry,init,serve} references in moved files — no dangling coupling.
String sweep targets match on-disk strings at tap.rs:24/26-27/33, trace_tui/mod.rs:4, config_tui/view.rs:90; GroveConfig shape matches core/src/config.rs:82.
Advisory: update.rs has ~12 explore_active guards (not just Save) — compiler-enforced removal via field deletion, so AC7 guarantees completeness.
Advisory: Step 8a first-run guard still keys on explore.json (pre-existing, not a regression); ensure non-interactive init paths seed explore.json to avoid non-TTY exec failure.
Advisory: Step 2 must implement Option<Cmd> -> Serve fallback so bare grove-explore (no subcommand, from .mcp.json) still serves; keep an assertion for it.

implementation.objective: Move config/trace TUIs + tap to grove-explore workspace crate; add forwarding shims in grove CLI; fix init.rs first-run TUI call; preserve GroveConfig.mode on save; string sweep; fix AC7 cold-target CI blocker.

grove_explore_bin() fix uses std::sync::Once + on-demand cargo build --locked -p grove-explore-bin, honours $CARGO, detects release/debug, bin.exists() short-circuits warm runs.
Full workspace: cargo test --release --locked --workspace = 340 passed, 0 failed. Clippy --all-targets --workspace -D warnings clean (exit 0).

approve.objective: Architectural sign-off on moving config/trace TUIs + tap to the grove-explore workspace crate with forwarding shims, string sweep, and TUI dependency isolation.
key_changes: All 7 ACs re-confirmed by independent code review (approved) and validation (approved: 340 tests passed, 0 failed; clippy --all-targets --workspace -D warnings clean).
On-disk state verified: grove-explore/src/ holds config_tui, trace_tui, tap.rs, main.rs; cli/Cargo.toml free of ratatui/crossterm; Cargo.toml workspace members include grove-explore.
AC6 dependency isolation is the key architectural win — heavy TUI deps (ratatui/crossterm) no longer bloat the grove CLI binary.
AC2 backward compatibility: grove config/tap forwarding shims remain one release, each printing the new spelling whether or not grove-explore is present.
AC5 config ownership: save path re-reads mode+harnesses from on-disk GroveConfig before writing, preventing guest-writer skew; covered by round-trip test.
AC4 ADR-0002 alignment: mode-gated inert-render path removed as moot; string sweep drops deprecated .grove/explore.json user-facing references.
Prior AC7 cold-target CI blocker resolved and independently reproduced (grove-explore-bin compiles mid-run; 42/42 CLI suite passes).
Deployment impact minimal: rides next release train, no migration/regeneration, no security scan; CHANGELOG should name the shim removal release.
Follow-up: extract the save-path GroveConfig-rebuild invariant into a shared helper so the round-trip test drives the real event_loop Save arm.
Follow-up: migrate init.rs:136 first-run sentinel off .grove/explore.json to a config.json-based sentinel when explore.json support is dropped.
Follow-up: schedule deletion of the grove config/tap forwarding shims for the named removal release.
